summary: Preserved the candidate's root-only tensor-parallel logits gather and sampled-token broadcast for compatible eager generation, while correcting both independently reproduced review counterexamples. DLLM_EXTEND now retains all-gather because dLLM consumes full_logits on every TP rank and bypasses ModelRunner.sample. Non-root gather ranks now clear grammar_mask and stale auxiliary_device_output without preprocessing absent logits.

remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so no real two-rank RCCL gather/broadcast serving or model execution and no collective performance comparison were possible.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot qualify tensor-parallel communication on one GPU or the distinct dLLM architecture, so it was not used as substitute evidence.

CUDA graph, speculative decoding, return-logprob, prefill-only, DP-attention, attention-TP, TP-LM-head all-to-all, and dLLM paths intentionally retain all-gather for correctness and therefore do not receive this optimization.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
